title: KrishiSetuDistrictRiskRecord
description: One district-level pest/disease risk advisory as bundled with the KrishiSetu AI app. These records ship inside the app (src/multilingual_data.js, getTelemetryData) so the risk list renders with no connection, and they are SAMPLE data - not live field reports. An earlier version of this file described a cross-state telemetry broadcast envelope (originStateCode, telemetryId, JSON-LD outbreak vectors). That feature was removed and never shipped; this schema documents the record shape that actually exists.

lat.description: Latitude the map marker is placed at.

lng.description: Longitude the map marker is placed at.

localisedAdvisory.description: The same advisory in one language. Every language block must be present: the app renders the block matching the selected UI language and has no runtime translation service.

origin.description: District the risk is currently reported in, e.g. "Ganjam".

target.description: District the advisory is addressed to, e.g. "Khurda".

pest.description: Pest or pathogen name, e.g. "Brown Plant Hopper".

severity.description: Localised severity label. English records use "High", "Moderate" or "Low"; the Odia and Hindi blocks carry their own translated label, so this is deliberately not an enum.

advice.description: One or two sentences of actionable advice for the target district.

en.advice: Farmers in Khurda should check paddy fields today. Outbreak detected in Ganjam.

or.advice: ଖୋର୍ଦ୍ଧାର ଚାଷୀମାନେ ଆଜି ଧାନ କ୍ଷେତ ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିବା ଉଚିତ୍।

hi.advice: खुर्दा के किसानों को धान के खेतों की जांच करनी चाहिए।
